type/category/wakeCategory.source: ACD_C172 (WTC L, RECAT-EU Light, APC A); POH172S/TEXTRON (MTOW 2,550 lb, single piston)

taxiSpeedKt.source: none authoritative found for GA taxi speed
taxiSpeedKt.status: UNVERIFIED simplification (kept). Typical practice is walking pace on ramps to about 15 kt on straight taxiways; no FAA/Cessna number exists. POH only says 'speed and use of brakes be held to a minimum'.

taxiTurnSpeedKt.source: DERIVED from POH172S minimum turning radius ~27 ft: omega = v/r = (8 kt = 13.5 ft/s)/27.4 ft = 0.49 rad/s = 28 deg/s

accelKtPerSec.source: DERIVED a = v^2/(2d): rotate 55 kt = 92.8 ft/s over TEXTRON takeoff ground roll 960 ft -> 4.48 ft/s^2 = 2.66 kt/s (POH172S table at 15 C interpolates to the same 960 ft)
accelKtPerSec.status: derived; current 2.8 also fine (gives 912 ft roll)

decelKtPerSec.source: DERIVED: TEXTRON landing ground roll 575 ft is MAX braking, flaps 30 -> 55 kt gives 4.4 kt/s, 50 kt gives 3.7 kt/s. Normal rollout to a taxiway exit is gentler

rotateSpeedKt.source: POH172S Section 4 Normal Takeoff: 'Elevator Control -- LIFT NOSE WHEEL (at 55 KIAS)'; short-field lift-off 51 KIAS

climbSpeedKt.source: POH172S Section 4: normal climb out 75-85 KIAS; best rate (Vy) 74 KIAS at sea level, 72 KIAS at 10,000 ft; Vx 62 KIAS

cruiseSpeedKt.source: POH172S Fig 5-8 (cruise, KTAS): 4,000 ft, 2400 RPM, 65% = 109-110 kt; 2500 RPM 69% = 115 kt. TEXTRON max cruise 124 ktas; POH max at sea level 126 kt

approachSpeedKt.source: POH172S: normal approach flaps 30 deg 60-70 KIAS; flaps up 65-75 KIAS; short field 61 KIAS

touchdownSpeedKt.source: No touchdown speed in POH. POH172S stall power-off 2,550 lb flaps 30: 40 KIAS / 48 KCAS (TEXTRON also 48 kcas); touchdown ~1.1-1.15 x 48 KCAS = 53-55 kt

climbRateFpm.source: TEXTRON 'Maximum Climb Rate 730 fpm'; POH172S Fig 5-6 sea level 710 fpm at 20 C, 785 at 0 C

descentRateFpm.source: ACD_C172 descent 500 ft/min (generic); POH has no descent-rate limit. On the 3 deg glidepath at 65 kt the required rate is ~345 fpm (DERIVED)
descentRateFpm.status: acceptable simplification (kept; only an upper bound off the glidepath)

turnRateDegPerSec.source: SKYBRARY rate of turn https://skybrary.aero/articles/rate-turn: rate one = 3 deg/s, bank ~ TAS/10 + 7 (about 17 deg at 100 kt)

groundTurnRateDegPerSec.source: DERIVED from POH172S minimum turning radius ~27 ft at 8 kt = 28 deg/s
groundTurnRateDegPerSec.status: should change 40 -> 30 (minor); 40 is faster than the airframe turns at 8 kt on a minimum-radius turn

minSpeedKt.source: POH172S Fig 5-3 stall at 2,550 lb: flaps up 48 KIAS (53 KCAS), flaps 30 40 KIAS (48 KCAS)

maxSpeedKt.source: EASA_TCDS 172S: Vno 129 KIAS, Vne 163 KIAS, Va 105, Vfe 85. TEXTRON: max cruise 124 ktas, max limit speed 163 kias
maxSpeedKt.status: should change 140 -> 129 (Vno); 140 is above structural cruising speed. 163 (Vne) is the absolute ceiling

takeoffDistanceFt.source: TEXTRON 'Takeoff Distance 1,630 ft' (over 50 ft obstacle), ground roll 960 ft; POH172S Fig 5-5 short-field, S.L., 15 C interpolates to 960/1,632
takeoffDistanceFt.status: verified (was 1,600). Field is at max weight, sea level, ISA, zero wind, paved level

landingDistanceFt.source: TEXTRON 'Landing Distance 1,335 ft' (over 50 ft obstacle), ground roll 575 ft

lengthM.source: TEXTRON 27 ft 2 in (8.3 m); ACD_C172 8.2 m

_not_in_type_shape.wingspan_source: TEXTRON 36 ft 1 in (11.00 m); ACD_C172 10.9 m
_not_in_type_shape.crosswind_source: POH172S Section 4/5: 'Maximum Demonstrated Crosswind Velocity: Takeoff or Landing 15 KNOTS' (not a limitation)
_not_in_type_shape.wake_srs_category: FAA JO 7110.65 same-runway-separation Category I (small single-engine <= 12,500 lb); see faa_7110_65_chap3_section_9.html
_not_in_type_shape.engine: Lycoming IO-360-L2A, 180 hp (TEXTRON)

type/category/wakeCategory.source: ACD_A320: WTC M (ICAO MEDIUM), RECAT-EU Upper Medium, APC C; SKYBRARY_A320 'M'. FAA 'Large' (> 41,000 lb, MTOW 73,500 kg)

taxiSpeedKt.source: Secondary only (web-search summary of an A319 Copenhagen 2012 accident report quoting the operator FCOM/Airbus FCTM): normal max 30 kt on long straight taxiways, ~10 kt for sharp turns. Primary Airbus FCOM/FCTM not retrievable
taxiSpeedKt.status: acceptable simplification (20 is below the quoted 30 kt maximum); primary source UNVERIFIED

taxiTurnSpeedKt.source: same secondary source (10 kt for turns of 90 deg or more); AIRBUS_AC min turning radius NLG 13.4 m -> 22 deg/s at 10 kt (DERIVED)

accelKtPerSec.source: DERIVED/ESTIMATE a = v^2/(2d): AIRBUS_AC Fig 3-3-1 (CFM56, ISA, sea level) shows ~5,000 ft balanced field at ~68 t and ~6,000 ft at the 73.5 t MTOW (chart-read, +/-300 ft). All-engine ground roll is shorter than the field length; ~3,800-4,100 ft (ESTIMATE, not a published number) to 140 kt gives 4.0-4.35 kt/s, i.e. ~35 s from brake release
accelKtPerSec.status: should change 2.8 -> ~4.0. At 2.8 the sim rolls 50 s / 5,900 ft to rotation, longer than the published field length for typical weights. ESTIMATE: no source states ground roll directly

decelKtPerSec.source: ESTIMATE. AIRBUS_AC Fig 3-4-1: landing field length at MLW ~4,800 ft = actual distance / 0.6 (actual ~2,900 ft from 50 ft; ground roll ~1,900-2,000 ft, which implies ~7 kt/s at max braking from 130 kt). 4.0 kt/s models a normal rollout to a high-speed exit
decelKtPerSec.status: acceptable simplification; no primary braking-rate source retrieved

rotateSpeedKt.source: ACD_A320 V2 (IAS) 145 kt at MTOW 73,900 kg; VR is a few kt below V2 and weight dependent

climbSpeedKt.source: ACD_A320 initial climb (to 5,000 ft) 175 kt IAS, 2,500 ft/min
climbSpeedKt.status: match (was 180; within 5 kt, 175 is the cited value). Note 14 CFR 91.117(b) 200 kt limit at/below 2,500 ft AGL within 4 nm of a Class C primary airport (KACY is Class C)

cruiseSpeedKt.source: CFR91.117(a): 250 kt IAS max below 10,000 ft MSL. ACD_A320 climb to FL150/FL240 290 kt IAS, cruise Mach 0.79 / 450 kt TAS
cruiseSpeedKt.status: verified as the sub-10,000 ft speed (this is a speed cap, not a cruise speed)

approachSpeedKt.source: AIRBUS_AC 3-5-0: final approach speed 136 kt at MLW 66,000 kg (A320-200), Aircraft Approach Category C; ACD_A320 Vat 137 kt
approachSpeedKt.status: verified (135 vs 136-137 at max landing weight; lighter weights are slower)

touchdownSpeedKt.source: DERIVED: Vapp 136 minus ~5 kt for deceleration in the flare. No published touchdown speed

climbRateFpm.source: ACD_A320 initial climb 2,500 ft/min (also SKYBRARY_A320); FL150 2,000, FL240 1,400

descentRateFpm.source: ACD_A320 descent FL240-FL100 3,500 ft/min, approach 1,500 ft/min

turnRateDegPerSec.source: DERIVED: 25 deg bank gives rate = g tan(bank)/V = 3.4 deg/s at 150 kt, 2.8 at 180, 2.0 at 250. SKYBRARY rate-of-turn quotes ICAO 'bank 25 deg or rate one, whichever requires the lesser bank'

groundTurnRateDegPerSec.source: DERIVED: AIRBUS_AC 4-3-0 min turning radius, nose gear R3 = 13.4 m, steering 75 deg -> 22 deg/s at 10 kt (theoretical maximum). 15 is a conservative taxiway-turn figure

minSpeedKt.source: ESTIMATE: below the 135-137 kt Vapp; no primary source for minimum manoeuvre speed retrieved

maxSpeedKt.source: ACD_A320 climb speed 290 kt IAS; CFR91.117 250 kt below 10,000 ft is applied elsewhere in the engine (SPEED_LIMIT_BELOW_10K_KT)
maxSpeedKt.status: acceptable simplification (A320 VMO 350 kt is not in the retrieved sources)

takeoffDistanceFt.source: AIRBUS_AC Fig 3-3-1 (CFM56, ISA, sea level, chart-read +/-300 ft): ~4,000 ft at ~63.5 t, ~5,000 ft at ~68 t, ~6,000 ft at 73.5 t MTOW. ACD_A320 reports 2,190 m (7,185 ft) at MTOW 73,900 kg (different engine/basis)

landingDistanceFt.status: match (as a factored required-runway length); actual demonstrated distance over 50 ft is ~2,900 ft

lengthM.source: AIRBUS_AC 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions: 37.57 m; ACD_A320 37.57 m
